plugins.name: code-formatter
plugins.description: Auto-formats code files right after the AI writes or edits them: unified layout (4-space indent, double quotes, semicolons, no width-based wrapping) for Vue/JS/TS/HTML/CSS/JSON/Markdown/YAML plus Java/PHP/SQL/Shell/TOML/Python/Go/C/C++; syncs prettier.* settings from VS Code/Cursor/Trae and respects the project's own .prettierrc

description_i18n.zh-CN: AI 写入/编辑代码文件后自动原地格式化：4 空格缩进、双引号、分号、不限行宽；自动同步 VS Code/Cursor/Trae 的 prettier 配置；支持 Vue/JS/TS/HTML/CSS/JSON/MD/YAML/Java/PHP/SQL/Shell/TOML/Python/Go/C/C++；项目 .prettierrc 优先
